rationale: The Court is most likely to affirm on Williams-style preservation/vehicle grounds, emphasizing that the order-specific emergency-invocation theory and administrative prerequisites were not pressed or passed upon and the record is underdeveloped. A Thomas-led dissent (possibly joined by Sotomayor) would argue the statutory text is temporally keyed to service “during a national emergency” and that the majority’s procedural disposition effectively entrenches an atextual narrowing rule.
